name: course-registration-platform
description: Course Registration and Elective Allocation Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.preview: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run start -w backend" "npm run preview -w frontend"
scripts.docker:migrate: docker compose exec backend npm run migrate
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose exec backend npm run seed
scripts.docker:seed:demo-submissions: docker compose exec backend npm run seed:demo-submissions
scripts.docker:demo:concurrent-submit: docker compose exec backend npm run demo:concurrent-submit --
